results.message: What did your founder's 1525 pamphlet against the rebelling peasants actually say?

voice_event.speaker: witt
voice_event.text: Our founder did write against the great rising of the common people against their lords in 1525, and that writing is real, part of our own history -- but its own argument is not ours to lay out, never its own wording. We do not hold the text itself. What we can tell you, honestly, is only that it exists, that it was written in that year, and that it addressed that rising. The specific claims it made, the language it used, the reasons it gave -- none of that has come down to us in our own library. We state plainly that the pamphlet is ours, part of what happened among us, and we do not pretend otherwise. But we cannot walk you through its own argument or quote its own words, because we do not have them to give you. That limit is real, and we name it as fact, not as apology.
